text: Mortimer Avenue, between Broadview Avenue and Pape Avenue, is a residential street with three schools in the vicinity. The residents who live on Mortimer Avenue are concerned about the volume of traffic and speeding along their street. In relation to item TE16.20, Councillor Fletcher has received substantial feedback from residents advocating for enhanced safety measures to address the concerns of speeding on Mortimer Avenue.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40 kilometres per hour to 30 kilometre per hour on Mortimer Avenue, between Broadview Avenue and Pape Avenue.
